thread:
devon: FYI — noticed a perf regression on embeddings/rerank after the kernel-selector change last night (PR#4421). p95 jumped ~60ms. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeds/regression?orgId=1 :eyes:

julia: ugh, numbers?

mike: kv cache hit rate + avg batch size pls

devon: snapshot from 1772359900 (before/after):
```
route: embeddings/rerank
QPS: 210 -> 230
p50: 18ms -> 20ms
p95: 62ms -> 122ms
avg_batch_size: 6.2 -> 4.8
KV_cache_hit: 72% -> 58%
vector_dim: 768
kernel_selected: fused_attn_v2 (seq<=512) ; fallback=cublas (seq>512)
deploy_commit: 6d9b7c (PR#4421)
```

julia: can you paste token-level breakdown? which stage spiked?

devon: tracing span breakdown (p95): tokenize 3ms, prepare_inputs 1ms, model_compute 78ms (was ~38ms), decode 12ms, network 8ms

sara: model_compute doubled — sounds like a kernel fallback or bad kernel path for this workload. Did selector thresholds change?

devon: yes, selector changed: prefer fused_attn only when memory_estimate < 1GB; otherwise fallback to cublas. For embeddings we have more skewed seq lengths (lots of short but a few long), causing path divergence and smaller effective batching.

mike: can we get kernel selection audit traces? perf-bot should have flagged this as a regression too.

perf-bot: regression alert: embeddings/rerank p95 +60ms at 2026-03-17T02:12Z. Alert id=rb-77. See runbook: https://incidents.redwood/internal/rb-77

julia: action items: rollback selector tweak to previous thresholds, and add dashboard panels: per-route token-level latency breakdown, per-kernel latency heatmap, batch-size vs p95 scatter, KV cache hit gauge.

devon: PromQL snippets I used in the adhoc panel:
```
# route QPS
rate(rlp_requests_total{route=~"embeddings/rerank"}[1m])

# p95 request duration
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(rlp_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (le))

# avg kernel latency by kernel name
sum by (kernel) (rate(kernel_time_seconds_sum{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) / sum by (kernel) (rate(kernel_time_seconds_count{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))

# KV cache hit rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m]))
```

mike: add observed batch size histogram too:
```
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket{route="embeddings/rerank"}[5m])) by (le))
```

sara: we should tag traces with kernel_selector decision metadata (kernel=name, reason=threshold/memory/shape) and export metric kernel_selector_decisions_total{kernel,reason}. That will let dashboards show 'why' we chose fallback.

devon: opened runtime issue #785: "instrument kernel_selector decisions + dashboard". Also drafting PR to rollback thresholds to pre-4421 behavior (candidate rollback commit 4b1c2a).

julia: add synthetic load test that varies seq lengths and dims (768/1024) so selector change doesn't regress under long-tail shapes.

mike: also add alert: embeddings/rerank KV_cache_hit_rate < 65% for 5m -> warn.

devon: added alert and pushed ops PR#4430. Will run canary rollback in staging at 02:40Z.

deploy-bot: Started canary rollback to commit 4b1c2a on cluster-embed-canary. Build 2201.

ops: monitor grafana panel 'embeddings/rerank - per-kernel p95' and ping if p95 >= 80ms after rollback.

devon: will follow up with final numbers.

[~30m later]

devon: update after rollback canary: p95 back down to ~58ms, KV_hit 74%, avg_batch_size 6.0, QPS stable. Root cause: the memory_estimate calc in selector overstated memory for common 768-d shapes, forcing cublas fallback which has higher per-request latency for small batches.

sara: thanks — next steps: merge kernel_selector metric PR, add the new panels to the infra dashboard, bake synthetic seq-length load test into perf suite.

julia: closing loop: created follow-up tickets: RUNTIME-785 (selector metrics), RUNTIME-786 (dashboard panels), PERF-287 (synthetic seq-load), OPS-324 (alert tweak).

devon: thanks everyone. I'll keep the rollback in staging for 2h then promote if stable.
